text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. The placement was exquisite too... 
Maybe it was a bit tricky this time.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“Still, watching from right beside you... 
I could tell you've gotten a lot better 
than before.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's why... thank you. For taking on the 
challenge again.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Let's get our revenge next time. I'm 
looking forward to it, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
